_description: Per-UpdateType confidence thresholds for the DegradingBackend. A successful extraction whose confidence falls below the matching threshold triggers escalation to the next backend in the cascade. Thresholds reflect the operational cost of a wrong extraction: CSAR and FIRE_MISSION demand high confidence before accepting a cheap model's output; FUEL and ambient-status messages tolerate lower confidence because the downstream cost of a miss is small. Unknown UpdateType values fall back to `default`. Set every threshold to 0 to disable cascading. Changes to this file are effective at next process start.
